make_hr_wkday <- function(ts, sc, tz) {
  real_times <- ymd_hms(ts, 
                        tz = tz[1], 
                        quiet = TRUE)
  dt <- data.table(source_country = sc,
                   wkday = weekdays(real_times),
                   hour = hour(real_times))
  return(dt)
  }
wkday_levels <- c('Saturday', 'Friday', 
                  'Thursday', 'Wednesday', 
                  'Tuesday', 'Monday', 
                  'Sunday')

attacks <- attacks %>%
  group_by(tz) %>%
  do(make_hr_wkday(.$timestamp, 
                   .$source_country, 
                   .$tz)) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(wkday = factor(
    wkday, levels = wkday_levels),
    hour  = factor(
      hour, levels = 0:23))

  mutate(percent = percent(n/sum(n))) %>%
  arrange(desc(n))

  filter(source_country %in% top4) %>%
  count(source_country, wkday, hour) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(source_country = factor(

  na.omit()

Rows: 550 Columns: 4

Delimiter: ","

dbl (3): Year, Yield, Production

ℹ Use `spec()` to retrieve the full column specification for this data.
ℹ Specify the column types or set `show_col_types = FALSE` to quiet this message.
library(ggrepel)

rice_filtered <- rice %>%
  mutate(Year = factor(Year)) %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(1961, 1980))

ggplot(rice_filtered, 
       aes(x = Year, y = Yield, group = Country)) +
  geom_line(color = "grey60", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(rice_filtered, Year == 1961),
    aes(label = Country),
    nudge_x = -0.2,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 1
  ) +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = subset(rice_filtered, Year == 1980),
    aes(label = Country),
    nudge_x = 0.2,
    direction = "y",
    hjust = 0
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Rice Yield of Top 11 Asian Countries",
    subtitle = "1961–1980",
    caption = "Prepared by: Cheng Ho Wang"
  )

ASEAN <- tsibble_longer %>%
  filter(Country == "Vietnam" |
         Country == "Malaysia" |
         Country == "Indonesia" |
         Country == "Thailand" |
         Country == "Philippines")
ASEAN_train <- ASEAN %>%
  mutate(Type = if_else(
    `Month-Year` >= "2019-01-01", 
    "Hold-out", "Training")) %>%
  filter(Type == "Training")
ASEAN_fit <- ASEAN_train %>%
  model(
    ets = ETS(Arrivals),
    arima = ARIMA(Arrivals)
  )
ASEAN_fit %>%
  glance()
